title: Sprint 115 Readiness Gate
scope_conditions: Account & Cloud Center work may begin only inside the approved corrective scope on the DELAYED path.
FULL_SCOPE_APPROVED requires a RELEASED path and a locally verified stable release health gate with no remaining incidents.
A ROLLED_BACK path is limited to corrective scope and cannot authorize full Account & Cloud Center expansion.
An unknown patch decision, failed local gate, or unapproved scope fails closed.
limitations: This gate records readiness for the approved corrective scope only; it does not claim v1.2.0 was publicly released.
The local corrective verification is not production health or external adoption evidence.
Account & Cloud Center expansion beyond corrective scope remains unavailable while the release path is DELAYED.
Public-trust signing, hosted CI, live telemetry, public incident intake, external adoption, hardware, and publication remain DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.
